texts.arguments: 3. It is argued by learned counsel for the petitioner that against the order of suspension of license for food business activity, petitioner preferred an appeal before the respondent no.2-Assistant Commissioner (Food), Food Safety and Drug Administration, District Mathura, which was numbered as appeal/2024-25/581 the same was rejected by the respondent no.2 vide order dated 05.03.2025 hence present writ petition.
